ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF MTS-(CLERK/DATA ENTRY
OPERATOR)
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the post of MTS
(Clerk/Data Entry Operator) purely on Contract basis.
No of Posts: 04
Qualification: Graduation or equivalent; Computer Literacy (with proof)
Age Limit: 18-37 years
Salary: fixed as per DC Rate
Hard copy of the Application Form along with the photocopies of certificates
should reach the office of Director, UILS by 21st Sept, 2026 (till 4:00 p.m.).
Sd/-
Director
